subject.why: The structure clearly depicts a ranch entrance gate with upright logs, crossbeam, and horseshoe.

category.why: The gate is set firmly on ground within an appropriate desert landscape.

clean.why: The image is free of text, borders, and extra figures.

framing.why: The top crossbeam crowds the left and right borders with insufficient margin.

colour.why: Warm sunset palette is vibrant, with solid separation between subject and sky.

detail.why: The asset maintains clean stylized shapes without clutter or micro-textures.

style.why: Smooth, chunky 3D rendering matches the game's established look.

fix: Scale down the gate slightly to provide comfortable margins on the left and right sides.
